breaking_news.headline: DOJ is investigating former congressman George Santos for insider trading on Kalshi
breaking_news.summary: The disgraced former congressman allegedly bet on whether he would appear at the State of the Union address, prompting federal investigations.

breaking_news.headline: Thieves are targeting the world's copper. This phone company is fighting back
breaking_news.summary: The value of copper is rising, and thieves can make money by stripping it from phone poles, streetlights and EV chargers. But those thefts cost the rest of us.

breaking_news.headline: Firings at CBS' '60 Minutes' reflect the fight for media control in the age of Trump
breaking_news.summary: The show's new leader says he fired star Scott Pelley for insubordination. Pelley says he was defending the integrity of the show's journalism after three top executives and two reporters were fired.

breaking_news.headline: Trump strips job protections from 8,000 federal workers
breaking_news.summary: President Trump signed an executive order that puts some 8,000 high-ranking civil servants into a new category of employees who can be fired for any reason.

breaking_news.headline: A former GEO Group executive now runs ICE. The company's government ties run deep
breaking_news.summary: David Venturella's appointment as acting ICE director is the latest in a pattern: Many former employees of the private prison company GEO Group end up working at the federal agency, and vice versa.

breaking_news.headline: As Strait of Hormuz stays shut, companies seek new routes for trade
breaking_news.summary: Shipping companies are looking for alternative routes as the Strait of Hormuz lockdown drags on.

breaking_news.headline: A handful of American households pay for AI. Is the future free — or a subscription?
breaking_news.summary: Just 3% of U.S. households pay for AI for personal use. Sign ups are growing — even though Americans have subscription fatigue.

breaking_news.headline: How cellphone carriers prepare for hurricane season with AI, drones and 'cows'
breaking_news.summary: Hurricane season is expected to be milder than usual this year. But that's not stopping cell phone companies from pulling out all the stops.

breaking_news.headline: Dutch police investigate suspected drugging and sexual assault of multiple women
breaking_news.summary: Police raided the suspects' homes after tip-offs from German and UK authorities.

breaking_news.headline: Charges dropped against Budapest mayor over 2025 Pride march
breaking_news.summary: Budapest's liberal Mayor Gergely Karacsony had been charged with helping to organise the banned 2025 march.

breaking_news.headline: Ukraine accused of killing four in occupied Crimea
breaking_news.summary: At least 10 people have been injured in the attacks, according to Russian-backed officials.

breaking_news.headline: Missing Sherpa guide found on Mount Everest after 'miracle' self-rescue
breaking_news.summary: Cleaners found Dawa Sherpa crawling towards Base Camp six days after he went missing at a higher altitude.

breaking_news.headline: Israeli strikes kill 11 people in Gaza City, medics say
breaking_news.summary: Women and children were among those killed in the attacks on four residential buildings, which Israel's military says killed four Hamas security officials.

breaking_news.headline: 'Crazy' phone call between Trump and Netanyahu complicates Iran talks
breaking_news.summary: Israel's PM laughed off reports of friction, but he has tested the patience of other US presidents.

breaking_news.headline: Trump hits back at 'unpatriotic' vote after House rebukes him over Iran
breaking_news.summary: The lower chamber of Congress passed a measure that seeks to halt further military action, in a vote seen as largely symbolic.

breaking_news.headline: Hezbollah rejects renewed ceasefire agreed by Israel and Lebanon
breaking_news.summary: The United States announced the ceasefire agreement on Wednesday night following a fresh round of talks.

breaking_news.headline: 'Apocalyptic' Tata Steel fire sees 'substantial' damage to production line
breaking_news.summary: Residents are advised to keep windows and doors closed as crews battle the fire in Port Talbot.

breaking_news.headline: Three-quarters of workers not on track for 'moderate' pension income, report suggests
breaking_news.summary: A newly-published report suggests a moderate lifestyle in retirement costs £32,700 for one person and £45,400 for two.

breaking_news.headline: 'By the grace of God': Miners dig on as lab-grown diamonds change market
breaking_news.summary: The rising popularity of lab-grown diamonds heaps pressure on those hunting for the natural gems.

breaking_news.headline: Who is Elon Musk and what is his net worth?
breaking_news.summary: The boss of X, Tesla and SpaceX is the world's richest person and has used his platform to make his views known on a vast array of topics.
